SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Discharge instructions

Take Amoxicillin 500 mg by mouth three times a day for 5 days.
Take Acetaminophen 650 mg by mouth every 6 hours as needed for 3 days.

Arrange follow-up with your primary care clinician within 7 days.
Seek urgent help for trouble breathing, blue lips, or new confusion.
Rest at home and drink fluids as tolerated.
